script_text: Brace yourself, Taurus; this week the cosmos rewires your foundations. Monday brings a Sun trine your 2nd House, boosting income and confidence; Tuesday brings Mercury square your 6th House, creating work stress; Wednesday shines as Venus conjuncts your 5th House, igniting romance. Mid‑week the Moon squares your 10th House, shifting focus to public recognition. Thursday’s Mercury sextile your 11th House encourages networking, while Saturday’s Mars trine your 1st House fuels personal drive and decisive action, and Sunday eases with a gentle Venus sextile your 4th House, bringing domestic harmony. Wednesday is your power day as Venus lights your 5th House, sparking love. Tuesday is your worst day as Mercury squares your 6th House, causing work confusion and mental strain. Prioritize clear communication and set realistic deadlines to navigate the mid‑week tension. Follow for daily updates.
